steps.content: Times are precarious. Demons roam the Earth. Fear abounds the heart... And hope... ehh... is nowhere to be found!
Yet in DisCity, the city of chaos, there is a figure like no other...
It stands apart from everything else around it...
And it always catches the attention of all... It is...
All right! Perfect moves, perfect slogan, perfect expression, perfect entrance, and perfect lion's head!

Hi everyone! I'm the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs, OwO! Remember my name, because soon it'll be known all over the world!
That's right, OwO!
Ow... wooo...
Jeez... I'm not howling, it's just my name, and it sounds great! Hurry up and change it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right! Today's the big debut for the superstar of the future! I know my 20 million viewers are all eager to see me lion dance, but I've prepared a bigger surprise for this vlog debut...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem, the DisCar Whatchamcallit Awards are happening soon, so all you little dummies competing to win, listen up. This year, the grand DisCars award will all go to OwO!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: As the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs, I'll win over everyone with my awesome and unique lion dancing skills!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Do you want to join this amazing journey? Wanna bask in OwO's glory up close? Want to leave your mark on this great masterpiece?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Then scan the QR code right now and sign up to join my crew! It'll definitely be the biggest, grandest, quirkiest, jolliest, liveliest journey that DisCity has ever seen!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We've already recruited a dummy clapper! That's ${PlayerName} behind the camera right now!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Come, come, ${PlayerName}, say hi to everyone!

options: No no no, this is OwO's time to shine. You continue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hi!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph, so you're not even going to show your face. Though your work skills are meh, your face is still very good-looking. I like it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What's there to be shy about? Though your work skills are meh, you're still someone I chose! Be confident!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Though he looks weak and inexperienced, not like someone you can count on, but that's okay! The most important quality for a person is to have vision!
steps.female_content: Though she looks weak and inexperienced, not like someone you can count on, but that's okay! The most important quality for a person is to have vision!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ${PlayerName} recognized my genius as soon as we met! And that's how I found this one, who was so eager to submit this resume right after hearing my grand movie plan! Not only that, this person also prepared a moviemobile for us to shoot!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So that's the second member to join our crew!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh, that's not right, you are the third one. We already have the crew's second cutest, second most special, and second most dazzling member... our lucky mascot, Stella!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: A lucky start is a must for any film project! Stella is our little guardian angel, who fell from the sky in a stroke of luck. It's a one-of-a-kind creature, and my...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it's me. The mission progress is...
After hanging up, you feel like apologizing a million times.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? What is it?

steps.speaker: Option
options: The alarm rang. Time is almost up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph, put your phone on silent next time. We can't always have it disrupting our work.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem, anyways, I'll give you more details next time. All in all, I've already created my filming diary, which I'll be updating from time to time. It'll record the birth of a masterpiece, a wonderful journey, and joyous friendships!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Everything is ready, and now we're just missing you! Dear...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Um... I guess... the... the scriptwriter? And what else... the makeup artist? Actors? Promoters?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Right, right! We welcome everyone to join My Best Cool Car Studios!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Well, I'll have to go work on the film now. See you in our next update!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I won't make you wait for long! Toodles!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Is it over? Did you turn the recording off?
You put the camera aside.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Phew... I didn't expect to be so nervous. How was I just now, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Absolutely splendiferous! That vlog alone is enough to win us a DisCar!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehehe, no way! I'm not even satisfied with it myself!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is OwO's first film ever. It must be polished to perfection. It's gotta have the best plot, the best acting, and be full of passion! Hmm... and it needs a perfect lion dance!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But we still had a little flaw just now.
You point to the little blue critter. It had been curled up in OwO's arms, but now that you're staring at it, it arches its back and bares its teeth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stella seemed a bit uncomfortable and didn't look good on camera. It detracted from your presentation. Why don't I take it to see the vet?

steps.speaker: Starbeast
steps.content: Bite...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, don't be mean to others!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You too, ${PlayerName}. Stella's different from other little creatures. It's very smart. Don't take advantage of the fact that it can't talk!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella isn't as gentle and patient as I am. It'll fight back!
She picks up the little critter and starts to head back.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There, there. Until you two learn to get along, I'll keep Stella with me.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I've been busy recruiting crew members for the past couple of days. I didn't even have time to practice lion dancing. I really have to find time!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You still haven't seen me lion dance, have you, ${PlayerName}? I'll make sure to show you a good one after I practice for a few more days.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, it's a unique art form that has been passed down for generations. No one in DisCity has seen it before. You'll love it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll get a DisCar for sure. By then, not only me, but also ${PlayerName}, Stella, and our new friends... Our names and movie will be famous all over the world! It'll be watched in every city-state, no matter how far away.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Of course. It's a DisCar, after all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName} & OwO
steps.content: The Walk of Fame where all wishes come true!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sorry, Chief. Hope I didn't disturb your plans just now.

steps.speaker: Option
options: No worries. OwO is very innocent. She trusts me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But that creature took an ordinary human child hostage, so it's a bit hard to handle.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft, what's so hard about it? It's actually the girl you can't handle, right? I'm dying of laughter here, Dummy, what kind of play are you setting up with her? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Weren't you upset and complaining just now? About how Chief didn't take you out to have fun this time?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Wahhhhhhh!
The two of them went aside to fight.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Apostle from the last Tide of Ashes is confirmed to have entered DisCity. It is adept at creating clones to hide its tracks. The FAC has already destroyed many of its clones, but has yet to find the main body.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The one you found is the most hidden and unique. As of now, it is also the only one left.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are you sure you don't want us to handle it? It's taking up your precious vacation days again.
You look at MBCC's disguised vehicle in the distance. The young Apostle of Ashes is sitting by the window, looking back at you.
A blue light flashes across its body, as if to taunt you.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...It's okay. It doesn't have any power to attack.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Plus, for me...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hee-yah!

The vehicle shakes violently. OwO must have done some high-difficulty moves inside. She likes to boast, yet always insists on practicing lion dancing out of view. She'll only show you when she feels ready.

steps.speaker: Option
options: For me, this is a nice vacation.

steps.content: A vacation doesn't always mean going to a resort. Chasing one's dreams is also a beautiful journey.

Come to think of it, in this world, only a kid would believe that a movie can be made in 10 days and win a DisCar. Only a kid would believe that by winning a DisCar, one can overcome the Apocalypse and bridge all boundaries.
...To let the world hear a small wish.
